title: Designer kit tokens that name the accent ramp carry the design's own values, so the design-system test is green on main

source.ref: Designer Theme Kit build, hotfix to LIVE-1741

detail: After LIVE-1741 landed, main's design-system test reported three fresh gaps: --color-accent-soft, --th-accent-bg and --th-accent-soft read var(--accent-300 / --accent-100), which no longer resolve against the repo token block on current main, while the design says #F2DCB8 and #F8ECD8. The three now carry those values. Nothing reads them, so no rendered site changes.

verify.evidence: The three tokens are literal values.
